name: handsfree
description: Handsfree — one line for your Claude Code: turn any site whose codebase you can edit into a voice + gesture controlled page, on top of WebMCP tools.

plugins.name: handsfree
plugins.description: One line for your Claude Code: the skill audits a site's existing frontend, registers its real capabilities as WebMCP tools (document.modelContext.registerTool), then injects handsfree.js — an LLM-free runtime that turns those tools into voice commands (Web Speech) and hand gestures (MediaPipe: index-finger cursor, air-tap to click, teal side bands to scroll, wave to go back/forward). Includes the injector CLI, the runtime, an interactive tutorial and a tool-authoring reference.
